intro: Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk is a gruesome hunting trophy taken from the leader of the Razormane quilboar raiders in the northern Barrens. Severing the tusk serves as indisputable proof for Thork at the Crossroads that the menace targeting Horde supply lines has been put down.

p: The supply caravans traveling west from Durotar into the Barrens face constant harassment, but recent attacks grew increasingly brazen under the orchestration of a fierce Razormane leader named Kreenig Snarlsnout. To cripple the quilboars' coordination, Thork—commander of the Crossroads watch—ordered Snarlsnout eliminated. Taking the chieftain's tusk not only offers concrete proof that the raider has fallen, but serves as a deliberate insult to the Razormane tribe, shattering their resolve and leaving their fighters without central direction.
